shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fur, fabric and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen.
